plugin.name: RehearsalPlayer
plugin.title: Rehearsal Player
plugin.desc: Dark, playlist-driven rehearsal playback with tutor/class filters, artwork playlist selection, large transport controls, quick jump presets, and a Spotify-backed teacher playlist section.
plugin.changes: Bug fix: a few UI symbols (the remove-row "X" in Teacher Playlists settings, and the default music-note icon) were embedded as raw UTF-8 characters that could render as garbled mojibake on servers that don't declare a UTF-8 charset for plugin pages. They're now written as JavaScript unicode escapes, which render correctly regardless.
plugin.creator: Jazzart
